comment_regular: Refresh an NPC's FaceGen state after actor 3D generation/rebuild. With bFixFaceNormals enabled, locates the named head geometry and stitches it to the first UpperBody geometry whose material name begins Skin using a 0.50-unit radius, then reapplies the absolute FaceGen render state to both cached nodes.
confidence_scope: Bulk synchronization preserves source annotations; it does not independently verify their semantic claims. Established focused conclusions are documented in Findings/OctoberPass/README.md.
